artifact.command: cd workers/pandapower && uv run --locked python scripts/run_studies.py

payload.title: AC N-1 screening — pglib-case118-ieee

method.severity: sum((L/100-1)^2 over overloads) + sum((dV/0.05)^2) + 100*(islanded_load + slack_excess)/total_load, slack_excess = sum(max(0, P_slack - Pmax_slack)); null for non_convergent/error (ranked first)
method.islanding: buses energised in the base case without a path to a slack; if every slack is cut off from the island with the largest load, the largest-Pmax gen there becomes the slack (row.slack_reassignment) and the old slack island is de-energised
method.class_precedence: error > non_convergent > islanding > thermal_overload > voltage_violation > secure

acopf.angle_difference_limits: not modelled by pandapower OPF (ANGMIN/ANGMAX ignored)

assumptions: Steady-state balanced AC power flow (Newton-Raphson); no protection, dynamics or transient stability.
Base operating point: pandapower AC-OPF (PIPS) generator set points; contingencies are not re-dispatched (generators keep P and voltage set points, the single slack absorbs imbalance).
Generator reactive limits are not enforced in the post-contingency power flow.
Thermal limit: apparent power at either branch end vs MATPOWER RATE_A (MVA); RATE_A = 0 means unlimited.
